translation: Baza babamba amabini aoosibini aseMidiyani, uOrebhi noZeebhi; babulala uOrebhi e lithwale liligama lakhe — sicwangcisa nantsi: “Babulala uOrebhi selithwale iROCK OREBHI elibizwa ngokwegama lakhe, noZeebhi babulala isihluzo se-winepress-of-Zeeb sibizwa ngokwakhe.” Intsingiselo esemgangathweni: “Babulala uOrebhi elityebileyo lithwale igama elithi Tsuru rOrebhi (isithsaba sikaOrebhi), uZeebhi babulala isihluzo esibizwa ngeYeqev-Zeebhi (isihluzo sikaZeebhi).” ukulandela ilogic yangoku: Baza balandela iMidiyani, baza kuthi intswele zikaOrebhi noZeebhi bazizisa kuGidhiyoni ngaphesheya komlambo iYordani.
